title: Chapter 474 Roland Empire Surrenders
content:
Chapter 474 Roland Empire Surrenders

Since Li Jianguo did not follow Wang Shuo here, Wang Shuo lacked long-range attacks, but Wang Shuo did not panic.

He has his own way to break the city.

First, he asked Ye Tianba to come downstairs of the city gate and start calling for formation.

After learning the siege methods of the Parthian Empire, Wang Shuo thought it would be a good idea to invite a battle first.

It would be great if the Roland Empire was willing to send experts to fight.

If they are too afraid to fight, their morale will definitely be low, which can be considered a gain.

Ye Tianba stood under the city gate and shouted at the top of his lungs: "You worms in the Roland Empire, if you can breathe, come down and fight Grandpa."

Violet stood on the city gate tower, her face looking very ugly.

Because there are currently three strongest kings in the empire.

They had already investigated clearly that the number of the strongest kings Wang Shuo brought this time was twice as many as theirs.

"What should I do?" She raised her eyes and looked at the general and the commander beside her.

Hearing Ye Tianba's yelling and cursing, the general couldn't bear it.

In all these years, he has never experienced such birdiness.

"Fuck you, fight the other side." The general said.

In fact, he was not just motivated, but carefully analyzed the current situation.

Instead of losing the city and being captured, it is better to fight now and at least die with dignity.

What soldiers pursue is to die on the battlefield, and they will definitely not be able to defend it.

Although Da Sima was also a person who had seen strong winds and waves, he was also worried about gains and losses at this time.

After all, no one wants to die.

He was even considering whether the Vana Empire would accept surrender. After all, he was also the strongest king.

Seeing that Da Sima didn't speak for a long time, Zi Luolan closed her eyes and had a headache.

"Your Majesty, please make a decision early." the general reminded.

"Let us surrender!"

Violet made a painful decision.

The general couldn't believe his ears.

Your Majesty actually wants to surrender?

"Your Majesty, why do you want to surrender?"

Da Sima can understand Violet's thoughts, because he thinks so too.

In this world, there is really no point in fighting and killing. It is better to stay away from these fights and live the life you want.

Zi Luo Lan walked to the edge of the city wall and said to Ye Tianba.

"General, please tell your Majesty that the Roland Empire is willing to surrender."

Ye Tianba cursed for a long time, his mouth was dry, and he saw someone finally coming out from the other side to answer.

But he didn't expect that what he heard was such a sentence that made him lose control.

In his mind, this Violet Empire can be said to be good at conquering and fighting, and its military strength cannot be underestimated. He is just about to show off his skills and have a hearty battle!

As a result, the other party surrendered.

This made him a little unhappy.

But since the matter was serious, he did not dare to make the decision without authorization.

"Are you Violet? Can you represent the Roland Empire?"

Ye Tianba asked with some suspicion.

"Exactly, go and tell your Majesty that we are willing to surrender, but we are not allowed to kill the people in the city."

Ye Tianba told Wang Shuo in the big tent in the distance about the news.

Wang Shuo was startled, and then a smile appeared on his face.

It's possible to have such an unexpected surprise.

"As soon as His Majesty showed his domineering aura, he immediately made his opponent surrender." Ye Tianba also flattered him.

Wang Shuo didn't know whether to laugh or cry.

"Since they surrender sincerely, let's accept it reluctantly! Ah! Hahaha..."
